newsitem.title: POLAND: POLISH ATLANTIS BUILDER CLEARED FOR PUBLIC TRADE.
newsitem.headline: POLISH ATLANTIS BUILDER CLEARED FOR PUBLIC TRADE.

text.p: Polish Securities Commission (KPW) cleared five million shares of initial public offering and 7.4 million existing shares in construction and trading firm Atlantis SA, the KPW said in a statement on Thursday.
The company, which seeks main market listing, offers 3.5 million shares in large investor tranche and 1.5 million shares in retail tranche from April 7 to 11.
Investors will have to subscribe to at least three million shares for the issue to become effective.
The company, controlled in 88 percent by a private investor earned net 1.6 million zlotys on sales of 39 million.
The company has 7.4 million shares outstanding.
